accepted_regressions.reason: NOT ATTRIBUTED, and the earlier reason recorded here was WRONG. It claimed a stale fixture build cache. That is impossible: both compile paths in fixture_harness.py (compile_fixture and _compile_rust_fixture) recompile unconditionally -- neither has an exists() short-circuit -- and defuse.jobs() enumerates DECLARED LANES, not files in build/, so no cached object can enter this census. The 17 six-day-old objects observed in build/ were real but cannot be the cause. Compounding it, the 7535 I compared against was never measured on a fresh build: I read it off a run whose .so had been reverted and not rebuilt. RULED OUT BY MEASUREMENT: the DWARF-signature and float-store work (9276b542) contributes zero -- stashing those patches out gives byte-identical per-function output, 1159/4472 both ways. REMAINING CANDIDATES: 965f8585 (exception/nested-split fix, which provably moved rustc:O2 by +15) and 72339ae5 (byte-view `not`, which changes SSA naming). A clean A/B could not be run because reverting cfg.rs to 965f8585^ no longer compiles against the current entry_shape.rs signature. Attribute this properly before trusting it.
NOT ATTRIBUTED -- same correction as the violations entry for this lane; the earlier stale-cache reason was wrong and is retracted there.

exception fix 965f8585 widens functions to their FDE-proven end, so bytes previously owned by NO function are now emitted. Named: gimli::read::abbrev::Abbreviation::new (+2, var0/var1, newly violating), alloc btree insert_recursing (+2, stack_4/stack_6), gimli::read::abbrev::Attributes::push (+1, var63) -- three functions, each replicated across fixtures 167/169/170. Proven by reverting ONLY cfg.rs+repair.rs, rebuilding, and re-censusing: 1156/4457, the committed numbers exactly. Recovering previously-dropped code necessarily raises a raw violation count.
the three Abbreviation::new copies, same cause as the violations entry above.

NOT a new violation -- a RENUMBERING. Count is 1 before and 1 after (the guard itself prints +0). Same single undefined read at the same position, 'var56 = var81;' in the else arm, with 'long var81;' declared and never assigned; it was 'var79' before. The byte-view 'not' fix changes how many temporaries the function emits, which shifts every subsequent temporary number. The per-cell census keys on the variable NAME, so a pure renumbering registers as one resolved plus one new.

the ARITY FIX in 11d55613 (live_in_arg_slots_llir: a read is live-in evidence only at version zero), NOT the prototype-recovery change in this commit. That commit shipped without regenerating the def-use baseline, because the census is not in the fast suite. Proven by reverting ONLY src/ir/value_number.rs to 11d55613^, rebuilding, and re-censusing: 7547/4466 -- the recorded ceilings exactly. Three other hypotheses were eliminated the same way first, each giving byte-identical output: the prototype-recovery patch, the DWARF/float-store work, and the source-path canonicalisation. Removing a spurious argument slot changes the recovered signature and therefore the body, so a raw violation count moves; the change itself can only ever REMOVE a slot, never add one.
same arity fix (11d55613); reverting src/ir/value_number.rs alone reproduces the recorded 4466 exactly.
